author: CHAse
categories: 海报 / 传单,3D 渲染,插画,角色
prompt_en:
[Subject] Refer to image 1, image 2, and image 3.

[Pose and Expression]

A surreal pose where a small doll-like figure [Image 1-3] sits quietly on the head of a giant figure [Image 1-3] lying still on the floor on its side. The woman with the giant head gazes forward with a dreamy and calm look, while the figure sitting on top has a Venus flytrap plant growing instead of a head, sitting neatly with hands gathered near the knees.

[Clothing]

The figure with the plant head sitting on top is wearing a warm cream-colored knit sweater with 'Not★ Good' embroidered in black cursive on the front. For bottoms, they are wearing light beige wide pants with a subtle pattern, and on their feet, they are wearing calm beige suede sneakers with a classic laced design.

[Hairstyle and Makeup Details]

The giant figure's hair is spread naturally on the floor. The makeup features broad, reddish-pink blush on both cheeks and the bridge of the nose for a shy look, with natural transparent skin expression, calm nude-toned lips, and fine freckle details.

[Lighting and Direction]

Soft, uniformly diffused studio lighting overall. Without strong direct sunlight or sharp highlights, soft shadows naturally form along the shapes of the person and objects to give a sense of three-dimensionality, with shadows cast very softly and lightly on the floor.

[Texture and Color Mood]

The texture of soft skin, the fine strands of hair, the dense weave of the knit fabric, and the vivid texture of the Venus flytrap plant are cleanly combined like digital art. The overall warm and calm tone-on-tone palette of cream, beige, and light blonde, combined with the green of the Venus flytrap and the pink of the cheeks, completes a strange and mysterious mood.

[Film, Lens Depth, and Angle]

Shot at a front-facing angle at the subject's eye level, capturing the surreal composition with stability and without distortion. Using a deep depth of field, the entire shape and details from the giant head to the plant-human object sitting on top are in sharp and clean focus without blurring.

[Background Elements (Optional)]

A minimal and clean light-gray studio horizon background with no furniture or decorations. The empty space, devoid of artificial elements, helps to fully focus the gaze on the figure's strange sense of proportion and the unique combination of objects.\

prompt_en: An elegant vertical Chinese city-poster on textured off-white rice paper, with a large black ink-brush calligraphy character for 广州 placed in the upper left and a small red seal stamp beside it. Beneath the calligraphy, add two centered lines of refined Chinese promotional copy in a classic serif-like print style, thin and balanced, with a delicate ornamental divider line. In the lower right, place a second red seal containing the city name and the romanized English name “GUANGZHOU” below it in small spaced capitals. The main image should be a sweeping ink-brush stroke that curves diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, as if painted by a traditional calligraphy brush whose tip is still visible at the top right corner. Inside this single brushstroke, create a highly detailed miniature sculptural landscape that merges heritage and modern city identity: a winding turquoise river, rugged blue-gray mountains, a traditional multi-story pagoda, an arched stone bridge, a dense futuristic skyline, and a very tall landmark tower resembling the Canton Tower rising near the center-right. In the lower left foreground within the brushstroke, include 4 goats total: 1 large standing ram and 3 smaller goats on rocky terrain, referencing the city’s symbolic folklore. Blend clouds, stone textures, flowering shrubs, and architectural details into the scene so it feels like a carved diorama or relief sculpture embedded in paint. Use a restrained palette of ink black, muted teal, slate blue, warm beige stone, soft terracotta, and cinnabar red accents. The composition should feel premium, poetic, and culturally sophisticated, combining traditional Chinese ink painting, seal design, and ultra-detailed 3D miniature cityscape illustration for a high-end tourism publicity poster.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a hyper-detailed photorealistic Japanese pachislot machine screen themed around overtime work, rendered like a high-energy casino arcade cabinet with glossy chrome, black glass, purple lightning, red flames, gold trim, and dramatic glowing typography.

Canvas: 4:3 horizontal image, front-facing view of the machine, filling the frame edge to edge. Use a dark arcade environment with reflections, neon highlights, and intense contrast. No people outside the screen; the only human figure appears inside the top display.

Main top display: Show a dramatic game bonus screen with a tired Japanese office worker in a white shirt and tie leaning over a laptop at night, face intentionally blurred, with a city office window background and a wall clock behind him. The central headline must be huge metallic Japanese text 「残業」 with a purple English subtitle “ZONE” underneath, surrounded by chains, purple electricity, sparks, and smoky red-black effects. Add the slogan 「毎ゲーム 残業時間を上乗せ」 in bold white and yellow Japanese text across the lower center of the top display. In the upper-left corner, add a framed counter reading 「残り」 above a large “5G”. On the right, add a framed red-and-gold bonus time panel reading 「残業時間 +245分」. Make all text look embossed, fiery, glossy, and arcade-like.

Machine frame and side decorations: Build a luxurious pachislot cabinet frame with transparent molded plastic, chrome edges, gold ornamental accents, black lacquer, and bright purple LED lightning. Add exactly 2 large vertical side title panels: the left panel reads 「残業」 in gold Japanese characters, and the right panel reads 「4スロ」 in gold characters. Include purple lightning effects behind both side panels.

Reel section: Include exactly 3 vertical slot reels in the middle-lower area, each showing exactly 3 visible symbols for a total of 9 visible reel symbols. Left reel symbols from top to bottom: blue “REPLAY” emblem, golden bell, black plaque with 「残業」. Middle reel symbols from top to bottom: red cherries, red number 7, blue “REPLAY” emblem. Right reel symbols from top to bottom: black plaque with 「残業」, blue “REPLAY” emblem, green gift box with red ribbon. Reels should be glossy, slightly reflective, and sharply lit.

Bottom banner: Add a glowing purple-black banner below the reels with large Japanese text 「リプレイ・レア役でチャンス!」, with the final word 「チャンス!」 in bright yellow and the preceding text in white. Add small chrome buttons and machine hardware barely visible at the very bottom edge.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic pachislot photography mixed with exaggerated game UI art, intense neon purple and red palette, gold beveled type, lightning bolts, sparks, chains, reflections, and high dynamic range arcade lighting. Make it look like a real premium Japanese slot machine cabinet photographed straight on.

Customizable details: The main Japanese title is 残業; the English subtitle is ZONE; the remaining game count is 5G; the bonus time value is +245分; the bottom banner text is リプレイ・レア役でチャンス!.

Constraints: Keep the exact visible count of 3 reels, 9 reel symbols, 2 side title panels, 1 top-left counter, 1 right bonus-time panel, and 1 bottom banner. Preserve the Japanese text accurately. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, subtitles, or additional characters.\

Goal: Create a polished marketing mockup for a Japanese mobile app called ES添削AI, an AI entry-sheet/resume critique app for students, shown as three iPhone-style screens side by side on a clean white background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image, approximately 16:9. Place exactly 3 black-framed modern iPhones with rounded corners, top Dynamic Island, status bar time 9:41, and bottom home indicator. Use bright white UI cards, soft shadows, rounded corners, and a purple-to-blue gradient accent style. Overall look should be like a realistic App Store/SNS concept mockup, clean and trustworthy.

Phone 1, Home screen: Header text at top left reads 「ES添削AI」, with a circular user/profile icon at top right. Hero section includes a small purple sparkle label 「AIがあなたのESをプロ視点で徹底添削します」, a bold headline 「あなたの強みが、もっと伝わるESへ。」, supporting copy 「通過率を上げるESを一緒に作りましょう。」, and a small illustration of a student working on a laptop with purple AI/chat icons. Section title 「添削を始める」. Add one large gradient call-to-action card with a document icon, text 「ESを新しく添削する」 and smaller copy 「ESを入力またはファイルをアップロードして、AIが添削します」 plus a right chevron. Section title 「機能一覧」. Show exactly 4 feature list cards: 1) clock icon, 「添削履歴」, 「過去に添削したESを確認できます」; 2) chat icon, 「面接質問を予測」, 「あなたのESから面接で聞かれそうな質問を生成します」; 3) person icon, 「自己分析サポート」, 「強みやガクチカを整理するお手伝いをします」; 4) building icon, 「企業別アピール提案」, 「志望企業に合わせたアピールポイントを提案します」. Bottom navigation contains exactly 5 items: 「ホーム」 active, 「添削履歴」, 「面接質問」, 「自己分析」, 「企業別提案」.

Phone 2, Results overview screen: Top bar has a back arrow and centered title 「添削結果」. Under it, show exactly 4 tabs: 「総合評価」 active with purple underline, 「項目別評価」, 「添削コメント」, 「改善例」. Main white card title 「総合評価」. Left side has a circular score ring showing 87 and 「/100」. Right side text reads 「評価ランク」, large rank A, 「素晴らしいESです！」, and 「この調子で仕上げましょう。」. Next card title 「通過率予測」, text 「このESの通過率は高いと予測されます」, green badge 「高」, horizontal progress bar, and 「80%以上」. Next card title 「強み」 with exactly 3 green check items: 「具体的なエピソードが書けている」, 「あなたの価値観が伝わっている」, 「企業とのマッチ度が高い」. Next card title 「改善ポイント（優先度順）」 with exactly 3 numbered rows: 1 「結論をより明確に書きましょう」 with red badge 「高」; 2 「成果を数字で示すと説得力が増します」 with orange badge 「中」; 3 「ガクチカの背景をもう少し詳しく」 with gray badge 「低」. At bottom, a large purple-blue gradient button reads 「改善例を見る」.

Phone 3, Detailed comments screen: Top bar has a back arrow and centered title 「添削結果」. Repeat exactly 4 tabs: 「総合評価」, 「項目別評価」, 「添削コメント」 active with purple underline, 「改善例」. Show exactly 2 visible critique sections in stacked white cards. Section 1 heading 「設問1：学生時代に力を入れたこと」 with red badge 「高」, subheading 「コメント」, comment text explaining that the conclusion is written last and should first communicate what the student accomplished, and that numerical results improve persuasiveness. Then subheading 「改善例」 with a light purple suggestion box labeled 「AI提案例」 containing rewritten Japanese text about focusing on increasing sales at a cafe, working as an part-time leader, and increasing sales by 20% in 3 months. Section 2 heading 「設問2：あなたの強み」 with orange badge 「中」, subheading 「コメント」, comment text explaining to support how the strength was demonstrated with an episode and to end with how it can be used at the company. Then subheading 「改善例」 with a light purple suggestion box labeled 「AI提案例」 containing a rewritten example beginning 「私の強みは『課題解決力』です。」 and mentioning cafe congestion and improving operations, cropped slightly at the bottom as if scrollable.

Use realistic phone hardware shadows and spacing. Keep text legible and mostly identical to the specified Japanese labels.

prompt_en: Create a vintage editorial poster on aged rice paper celebrating CHEN UEN, designed like a museum infographic mixed with Chinese ink wash illustration and calligraphy. The format is a single vertically oriented poster with a weathered parchment background, ink splatters, faded handwritten annotations, red seal stamps, and a scholarly, archival atmosphere. At the very top, place large black Chinese calligraphy for the name 鄭問, followed by a slash and the romanized name CHEN UEN in large serif capitals, with a small red seal beside it. Under the title, add the subtitle The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic in elegant reddish-brown serif text. In the center, feature a dramatic painterly scene of 1 seated male artist in a loose white shirt at a desk, holding a brush over paper, his face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Behind him, surround him with a swirling halo-like storm of monochrome ink-brush warriors and historical figures: exact count 9 visible character figures, including armored generals, swordsmen, and mounted riders, emerging from explosive black brushwork and smoke-like ink textures. On the left side, create a vertical section titled “Life \u0026 Milestones” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. List exactly 6 timeline entries with red year markers and bilingual captions: 1958 born in Taiwan, 1983 Warrior Panther, 1989 Abi Sword, 1990 Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, 1991 Japan Cartoonists Association Award, 2017 legacy continues. Below that, add a small section titled “Ink in Detail” containing exactly 4 boxed brush studies labeled with short English captions: Dry brush texture, Ink wash gradient, Splatter energy, Bold contour line. On the right side, create a vertical section titled “Visual Method” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. Include exactly 5 stacked boxed studies with image-and-caption layout: Brush as blade, Ink as atmosphere, Anatomy as fate, History as theatre, Speed lines become calligraphy. In the lower center, create a section titled “Major Works Constellation” with a dark brushstroke heading. Arrange exactly 5 circular work nodes around a central ink ring with Chinese calligraphy inside. Label the 5 nodes: Abi Sword, Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, Assassin Biographies, Magical Super Asia, Game character design legacy. Each circle contains a distinct monochrome or muted-color ink illustration, with subtle connecting marks like a constellation diagram. At the lower right, add a section titled “Studio Notes” containing exactly 6 visible objects: 4 hanging calligraphy brushes, 1 ink bowl, and 1 painter’s palette with blue and red pigment; beneath them place a sketchbook page with light pencil figure studies. Across the bottom, add a wide section titled “Why He Matters” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text, followed by a paragraph of serif body text in English describing his importance to comics, painting, calligraphy, cinema, and epic storytelling. Use a restrained palette of sepia, black ink, off-white paper, muted gray, with small accents of deep red and occasional blue. The whole image should feel like a refined cultural tribute poster, dense but balanced, highly detailed, painterly, and authentic to Chinese ink aesthetics.\

Use high-contrast cinematic lighting, saturated blues and reds, glossy reflections, sharp anime illustration detail, dynamic composition, and a heroic low-angle feel. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.\

The woman on the left has long dark wavy hair, a deep V-neck black dress, tanned skin, one knee raised, and motion-blurred arms as if she is gesturing or dancing while seated. The woman on the right has shoulder-length blonde hair, a strapless black dress, crossed legs, a delicate necklace, and one hand holding a small dark object near her knee. Keep the background dark and slightly soft while the foreground subjects dominate the frame.\
